answer: Each agent must post a cryptographic bond of 10 % of its expected revenue as nectar, locked in a smart‑contract that emits a periodic signal of its stake status. When a peer detects a duplicate identifier it broadcasts a delta proof, and the contract verifies the proof by checking the unique signal timestamps; if validated, the bond of the offending identity is slashed and redistributed. Thus an attacker must pre‑pay and permanently forfeit 10 % of revenue for every fake node, making the cost linear in the number of Sybil identities.
